summary: Backend critical-flow regression passed 3/3. Public mobile preview rendered, player login succeeded, and game navigation reached Werft; calculator screen was visibly rendered. Login inputs lack accessible labels/testIDs, and the scripted calculator interaction timed out during the asynchronous tab transition.

ui_bugs.issue: Spielername and Passwort inputs render without aria labels, placeholders, or data-testid attributes; label-based automation/accessibility cannot identify them reliably.

integration_issues.issue: Login succeeds and Werft renders, but the automated calculator-button lookup timed out during the tab transition; calculator was visible in the captured page afterward. Needs retest with an explicit tab render wait.

action_items: Add data-testid and accessible labels (or aria-label) to both login inputs.
Retest calculator opening and controlled quantity inputs after waiting for Werft tab content to mount.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend auth initialization calls and component validation are present; regression suite confirms seeded login, buildings, research, spaceport, invite, and component APIs.
Frontend uses controlled state in SpaceportTab and ShipyardTab; no document.getElementById usage was found in the referenced components.
seed_data_creation: Created one single-use admin invite during the regression test; no new player was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL now serves the app. Use mobile viewport 375x667. Login input DOM has two unnamed inputs in order: text then password. TestUser1/password123 login succeeds and redirects to game UI.
rca_of_issue: The login form visually displays separate labels but does not associate them with input elements and provides no stable testIDs, causing get_by_label selectors to time out. The calculator timeout occurred while the Werft tab was still transitioning/rendering; the screenshot showed the Werft content and calculator button afterward, so this is currently a test synchronization finding rather than confirmed product failure.
